svg.title: A day's steps reaching Apple Health

g.text: A day's steps reaching Apple Health
Encrypted and MITM protected, or the watch
refuses the read, the write and the subscribe.
day: absolute total for the watch's own date
sum the samples we wrote for that date
An empty date comes back as errorNoData.
That is a sum of zero, not a failure. Reading
it as a failure meant the first sample of a
new day was never written, so the date stayed
empty and the query kept failing.
Retried on the next push, on unlock, on an
Reconnecting forces a fresh discovery and a fresh
CCCD write, which is what the watch is waiting for.
